reason: The text fragment (Exodus 2:16-22) is a narrative account of Moses helping the daughters of the priest of Midian at a well, being received hospitably, and marrying Zipporah. There is no appearance of Yahweh in the passage, no divine speech, and no complaints directed at the people. The passage contains only narrative description and brief dialogue between the characters (the daughters, their father Reuel, and Moses), with no theological complaint or divine reproach.
